note: Both sets capture the same core facts (window azimuth 0, truncated isosceles triangle shape, 25-degree bend, the depth-to-height algorithm, 50-degree solar altitude at fall equinox 12pm, and 1:1 ratio), and both contain redundant duplicate claims. Set A's duplicates (shape and bend angle each listed twice) are redundant but faithful to the text. Set B additionally misbinds the 50-degree solar altitude to the 'Harvest Shade Screen' as if it were a property of the screen, when the text presents it as a site-specific solar altitude used as an input; it also duplicates the solar altitude claim. Set A therefore has fewer misbound/unsupported claims while keeping the same correct content.
